_comment: Kickoff times where a school publishes something other than what CFBD
returns. These are NOT corrections: the page still shows the fetched
time, because that is what the rest of the site is computed from and a
hand-edited clock would drift from it silently. They are flags, so a
reader sees that the number is contested and where the other one comes
Keyed by CFBD game id. `published` is the venue-local time the source
gives, 24-hour. Remove an entry once CFBD agrees with it.
Found by hand. There is no signal in the feed for this — CFBD does not
mark a time as provisional once it has one, so nothing but a person
comparing against the school's own page will catch it.

401856774.note: Arizona State lists 7:00 p.m. MST for the Morgan State opener; ESPN's kickoff-time announcement says 7 p.m. Arizona time. CFBD returns 6:00 p.m.
